name: QuerySnapshotJobList

parameters.help_en:
The list of snapshot job IDs.
You can query up to 10 IDs at a time. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). 
You can obtain the IDs from the MPS console (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) by choosing Job Management > Snapshots, or from the response parameters of https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/602857.html
parameters.help_zh:
截图作业ID列表。
一次最多查询10个，半角逗号（,）分隔。 
可以通过MPS控制台 (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview)>任务管理>截图获取，也可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/602857.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: snapshot_job_ids

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next page, which is a 32-character UUID.
If the query results exceed one page, the NextPageToken parameter is returned and updated with each query. Use the returned token in the next query
parameters.help_zh:
下一页标识，32位UUID。
查询结果大于一页会返回NextPageToken参数，每次查询值都会更新。获取后请在下一次查询时填入
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paging query.

Valid values: [1,300].
Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询每页最大返回数。

取值范围：[1,300]。
默认值：30
parameters.name: maximum_page_size

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot status to query. Valid values:
Submitted: The job is submitted.
Snapshoting: The snapshot is being taken.
Success: The snapshot is taken successfully.
Fail: The snapshot fails
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的截图状态。
Submitted：已提交。
Snapshoting：截图中。

Success：截图成功。

Fail：截图失败
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The earliest time when the job was created.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. The time must be in UTC.
Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
最早任务创建时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_of_job_created_time_range

parameters.help_en:
The latest time when the job was created.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. The time must be in UTC.
Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
最晚任务创建时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。
格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_of_job_created_time_range

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the MPS queue. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29197.html.
Valid values: You can query and create MPS queues in the MPS console (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview) by choosing Global Settings > MPS Queues.
If you require asynchronous notifications, bind an MNS message to the MPS queue. For more information, see <props="china">Receive message notifications (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">Receive message notifications (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/apsaravideo-for-media-processing/latest/receive-message-notifications)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
管道ID。详细信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29197.html。
可选值：可以通过MPS控制台 (https://mps.console.aliyun.com/overview)>全局设置>管道查询和创建。
如果需要异步通知，请为管道绑定MNS消息，详细说明请参见<props="china">接收消息通知 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42618.html)</props><props="intl">接收消息通知 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/apsaravideo-for-media-processing/latest/receive-message-notifications)</props>
parameters.name: pipeline_id

NextPageToken.description_en: The token for the next page, which is a 32-character UUID. This parameter is returned and updated with each query when the query results exceed one page
NextPageToken.description_zh: 下一页标识，32位UUID。查询结果大于一页时返回，每次查询值都会更新

String.description_en: The list of non-existent snapshot job IDs
String.description_zh: 不存在的截图作业ID列表

items.description_en: The details of the non-existent snapshot job IDs. This parameter is not returned if no data is available
items.description_zh: 不存在的截图作业ID详情，无数据时该参数不返回

Code.description_en: The error code returned when the snapshot fails. This parameter is not returned if the job is successful
Code.description_zh: 分析失败时错误码。如成功则不返回此参数

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the job was created. The time is displayed in UTC and formatted in accordance with the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreationTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

Id.description_en: The ID of the snapshot job

Bucket.description_en: The OSS bucket where the input file is stored

Location.description_en: The data center where the input OSS bucket resides (OSS location)
Location.description_zh: 输入OSS Bucket所在数据中心（OSS Location）

RoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the specified role. Format: acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName

MNSMessageResult.description_en: The result of the MNS notification sent to the user upon job completion
MNSMessageResult.description_zh: MNS通知用户作业完成的结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the notification fails. This parameter is not returned if the notification is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 失败时错误码。如成功则不返回此参数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the notification fails. This parameter is not returned if the notification is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 失败时错误信息。如成功则不返回此参数
ErrorMessage.example: The resource operated InputFile is bad

MessageId.description_en: The message ID returned when the notification is successful. This parameter is not returned if the notification fails
MessageId.description_zh: 成功时消息ID。如失败则不返回此参数

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the snapshot fails. This parameter is not returned if the job is successful
Message.description_zh: 分析失败时错误信息。如成功则不返回此消息
Message.example: The resource operated InputFile is bad

PipelineId.description_en: The ID of the MPS queue

FrameType.description_en:
The snapshot type. Valid values:

normal: normal frame.

intra: I-frame.

Default value: intra
FrameType.description_zh:
截图类型。

normal：普通帧。

intra：I帧。

默认值：intra

Height.description_en: The height of the output snapshot image

Interval.description_en:
The time interval between snapshots.

If this parameter is specified, sequence snapshots are taken, and the value must be greater than 0.
Unit: seconds.
Default value: 10
Interval.description_zh:
截图间隔时间。

若指定则表示序列截图，且值大于0。
单位：秒。
默认值：10

Num.description_en: The number of snapshots. If this parameter is specified, sequence snapshots are taken
Num.description_zh: 截图数量。若指定则表示序列截图

OutputFile.description_en: The OSS configurations for the snapshot output

Bucket.description_en: The OSS bucket where the snapshot output file is stored
Bucket.description_zh: 截图输出文件所在OSS Bucket

Location.description_en: The data center where the OSS bucket for the snapshot output resides (OSS location)
Location.description_zh: 截图输出OSS Bucket所在数据中心（OSS Location）

RoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the specified role. Format: acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName

CellHeight.description_en: The height of a single image. Default value: the height of the snapshot output resolution
CellHeight.description_zh: 单图片高度。默认截图输出分辨率高度

CellSelStep.description_en: The step size for selecting a single image

CellWidth.description_en: The width of a single image. Default value: the width of the snapshot output resolution
CellWidth.description_zh: 单图片宽度。默认截图输出分辨率宽度

Color.description_en:
The background color.
Default value: black.
Valid values: color keyword and random.

Color keywords support three formats. For example, black can be represented as Black, black, or #000000
Color.description_zh:
背景颜色。
默认：black。
可取值范围：颜色关键字，random。

其中颜色关键字支持三种格式，比如黑色，支持Black，black，#000000

Columns.description_en: The number of columns in the image sprite. Default value: 10

IsKeepCellPic.description_en: Specifies whether to retain single images. Default value: true

Lines.description_en: The number of rows in the image sprite. Default value: 10

Margin.description_en:
The width of the outer frame.

Default value: 0.

Unit: pixels
Margin.description_zh:
外框宽度。

默认：0。

单位：px

Padding.description_en:
The spacing between images.

Default value: 0.

Unit: pixels
Padding.description_zh:
图片间距。

默认：0。

单位：px

TileOutputFile.description_en: The OSS configurations for the output image sprite
TileOutputFile.description_zh: 拼图任务大图的输出OSS配置

Bucket.description_en: The OSS bucket where the output file is stored

Location.description_en: The data center where the output OSS bucket resides (OSS location)
Location.description_zh: 输出OSS Bucket所在数据中心（OSS Location）

RoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the specified role. Format: acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName

Time.description_en: The start time of the snapshot. Unit: milliseconds
Time.description_zh: 截图开始时间。单位：毫秒

TimePointList.description_en: The array of specified time points

items.description_en: The array of specified time points. Unit: milliseconds. The values are floating-point numbers with two decimal places. The values can be duplicate and submitted out of order, and are sorted by MPS. You can specify up to 100 time points. If this parameter is specified, do not specify Num, Time, or Interval. Otherwise, the InvalidParameter.Ambiguity error is reported
items.description_zh: 指定时间点数组，单位毫秒，浮点数，保留2位小数，可重复，可无序提交，由MPS排序。最多100个时间点。指定该参数时，Num、Time、Interval均不指定。如指定则提示参数指定错误 InvalidParameter.Ambiguity

Width.description_en: The width of the output snapshot image

State.description_en:
The snapshot status. Valid values:
Submitted: The job is submitted.
Snapshoting: The snapshot is being taken.
Success: The snapshot is taken successfully.
Fail: The snapshot fails
State.description_zh:
截图状态。
Submitted：已提交。
Snapshoting：截图中。

Success：截图成功。

Fail：截图失败

TileCount.description_en: The number of images in the image sprite
